title: Learning Recommendation Engine
description: Transform LearnerSnapshot into prioritized educational actions. The engine consumes a LearnerSnapshot, applies 5 rule modules (mastery, recovery, review, misconception, engagement), scores each candidate action, deduplicates, and returns the top 5 recommendations.

userStories.title: Domain models: LearningActionType enum + LearningRecommendation model
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the domain types for recommendations defined so that rules and scoring can use them.
acceptanceCriteria: LearningActionType enum has 9 values: REVIEW_TOPIC, TAKE_QUIZ, COMPLETE_RECOVERY_TASK, REVISE_MISCONCEPTION, STUDY_DIAGRAM, READ_CONTENT, ASK_TUTOR, EXAM_PRACTICE, MAINTAIN_STREAK

LearningRecommendation Pydantic model has fields: id (str), action_type (LearningActionType), topic (str|None), priority_score (float, default 0.0), reason (str, default empty), explanation (str, default empty), generated_at (datetime), metadata (dict, default empty)
Package created at recommendation/models/ with __init__.py re-exporting both
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: All action types defined up front even though only 4 are active in Phase 1. Keep enum in separate file from model.

userStories.title: Priority scoring calculator with weight config and dedup
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a scoring function that converts raw weights into normalized 0-1 priority scores and deduplicates recommendations by (action_type, topic).
acceptanceCriteria: PriorityCalculator class with RAW_WEIGHTS dict: critical=40, moderate=25, mild=10, good=0, overdue_1_3=10, overdue_4_7=20, overdue_8plus=30, misconception=20, active_plan=15, near_completion=10, streak_risk=10, inactive=15
MAX_POSSIBLE_SCORE constant = 120
normalize(raw: float) -> float divides by 120, clamps to [0.0, 1.0]
deduplicate(recommendations) -> list merges same (action_type, topic), keeps higher priority_score
score_and_sort(recommendations) -> list applies normalize + dedup + sort desc + returns top 5
Package at recommendation/scoring/ with __init__.py
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Fixed denominator normalization ensures consistent scale across all recommendations.

userStories.title: All 5 rule modules: mastery, recovery, review, misconception, engagement
userStories.description: As a developer, I want rule modules that inspect a LearnerSnapshot and produce candidate recommendations with raw priority scores.
acceptanceCriteria: mastery_rules.py: generates REVIEW_TOPIC for topics with severity 'critical' (raw=40) or 'moderate' (raw=25). Uses snapshot.mastery_by_topic and weak_topics.
recovery_rules.py: generates COMPLETE_RECOVERY_TASK for each active recovery plan (raw=15). Adds +10 bonus if progress_pct >= 80 (near completion). Uses snapshot.active_recovery_plans.
review_rules.py: generates REVIEW_TOPIC for each due review (raw=10 for 1-3 days overdue, 20 for 4-7, 30 for 8+). Uses snapshot.due_reviews.days_overdue.
misconception_rules.py: generates REVISE_MISCONCEPTION for each misconception with frequency >= 2 (raw=20). Uses snapshot.misconceptions.
engagement_rules.py: generates MAINTAIN_STREAK if streak <= 1 (raw=10) or recent_activity_score < 0.3 (raw=15). Uses snapshot.gamification.

Each rule module is an async function: generate(snapshot: LearnerSnapshot) -> list[LearningRecommendation] with priority_score set to the raw score (not yet normalized) and a human-readable reason string
Package at recommendation/rules/ with __init__.py re-exporting all 5 generate functions
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Raw scores are set by rules; normalization happens in PriorityCalculator. Each rule is independent - no cross-rule dependencies.

userStories.title: Recommendation engine orchestrating rules + scoring
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the engine that calls all rules, scores, deduplicates, and returns top 5 recommendations.
acceptanceCriteria: RecommendationEngine class with async generate(snapshot: LearnerSnapshot, user_id: UUID) -> list[LearningRecommendation]
Calls all 5 rule generators (mastery, recovery, review, misconception, engagement) in parallel via asyncio.gather with return_exceptions=True
Passes raw recommendations through PriorityCalculator.score_and_sort() for normalization, dedup, and top-5 selection
Each recommendation gets a unique id like 'rec_{user_id_short}_{index}' after scoring
generated_at set to now for each recommendation
Package at recommendation/services/ with __init__.py
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: parallel gather mirrors the SnapshotBuilder pattern. Degraded snapshot = empty fields = fewer/no recommendations.

userStories.title: Recommendation service with caching
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a cached entry point for recommendations that fetches the snapshot, runs the engine, and caches results.
acceptanceCriteria: RecommendationService class with async get_recommendations(user_id: UUID) -> list[LearningRecommendation]
Fetches snapshot via SnapshotService.get_snapshot()
Runs engine.generate(snapshot, user_id)
Caches result in CacheManager with key prefix 'recommendations:{user_id}', 5-min TTL
Cache hit returns deserialized recommendations directly
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Reuses existing CacheManager from snapshot module. No explicit invalidation - TTL-only, matching the snapshot pattern.

userStories.title: API endpoints: GET /intelligence/recommendations/{user_id} and GET /intelligence/next-action/{user_id}
userStories.description: As a learner, I want to retrieve my top recommendations and single best next action via the API.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /intelligence/recommendations/{user_id} returns JSON array of top 5 recommendations, each with action_type, topic, priority_score, reason, explanation
GET /intelligence/next-action/{user_id} returns single highest-priority recommendation or empty object if none
Both endpoints perform user existence check (404 if not found) matching existing pattern in intelligence router
Endpoints use Depends(get_session) and Dependency Override compatible for tests
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Added to existing src/api/intelligence/router.py. Follows the same pattern as GET /intelligence/snapshot/{user_id}.
